Sell Plan · two figures, row control

Sale sheet · filled for a mark

annotations.text:
Surfaces 1 + 2 — the Items tab: the Owned / Sold switch and the Sold side.
One consistent set of figures runs through the whole canvas: three sales — Technics SL-1200 $1,200 (paid $850, gain $350), Vox AC15C1 $660 (at cost), Fender Blues Junior IV $540 (paid $690, loss $150). They total $2,400 and +$200, so the Sold side summary and the Dashboard card read +$200 where the brief's example said +$350.

The switch — a Sort By badge split in two.
1px accentBrass border, 3px radius, 32 tall (the badges' own height), two 62-wide halves, IBM Plex Mono 11. Active half: accentBrass fill, background ink, weight 500 — the Sell Plan checkbox's checked idiom, so the side showing survives greyscale. Inactive half: no fill, accentBrass text at 400 — the badge's own 'tap me'. No seam; the fill is the divide.
Placement: its own row under the title block, left-aligned with the title — controlRowGap (16) below the meta line, sectionGap (24) above the search field. On the Sold side it is the header's last element, 15 above the first row (the list's 10 + a row inset of 5). Sort By and search go; the '…' stays.
The summary line stays in the title's meta slot on both sides (the plan's soldSummaryLine) rather than moving under the switch: title + meta is every list header's shape, and the switch then sits between the header and the content it switches.
Motion: the fill slides to the tapped half on .snappy(0.25) while the rows cross-fade; the fade alone under Reduce Motion. One element to VoiceOver — 'Owned or sold', value the side showing.

Decision 10 — words, the amount, and its basis.
Rows and the page: 'Gain $350 vs paid' / 'Loss $150 vs paid' / 'At cost'. One form in both places; the page sets it larger.
The first word carries gain or loss; colour (accentMossText / accentRustText) only repeats it, and at cost is neither (textLabelSecondary on a row, textBody on the page). 'vs paid' names what it is measured against — it matters on a page where WORTH NOW sits just below — and is the app's existing phrase. 'At cost' drops 'Sold' because the row's date line and the page's tag already say it.
A sold row is the Owned row with the dial removed and the value line's delta replaced by the outcome: two sides of the same row. Date line in monoLabel. A stock photo keeps its corner mark.

Empty Sold side — EmptyStateView as shipped, over the switch, no action.
Mark proposed as SF 'tag' (the menu row's glyph), 34pt light at textInactive, in place of the Items tab mark — it says 'sold', not 'items'.
The meta line reads '0 SOLD · $0': the realised part is dropped at zero. That is a copy question, listed in the notes, not settled here.
Surfaces 3 + 4 — the Dashboard's Sold card, and the sold item page.

Sold card — plated, not outlined.
It holds figures, and figures sit on plates (Spent / Gain). The outline belongs to the un-valued callout's 'something is missing' voice and to the brass buttons' 'act' voice.
It reads apart from the totals by register, not by chrome: SOLD monoLabel inside the card; the figures at IBM Plex Mono 15 (the breakdown rows' size, well under Spent/Gain's Archivo 26) with the count in textBody and the proceeds lifted to 500 textPrimary (the market line's lift); the realised line at monoMeta 11.5 in moss or rust. cardPadding 16; 6 label to figures, 4 figures to realised.
Tap cue: the callout's own brass arrow.right, 11pt medium, without a word (there is no copy for one). The whole card is the button.
Root: after the callout, before BY CATEGORY. Drilled in: the same card with the scope's figures (Audio: 1 item · $1,200 · +$350 vs paid) — drawn here with no callout, so it sits directly under Spent/Gain. With nothing sold in scope the card is absent and BY CATEGORY moves up.

Sold page — the mark leads the page, above the photo hero.
A SOLD tag — textPrimary fill, background ink, monoLabel type, 2px radius (a label's radius, not a button's 3) — with the outcome beside it at IBM Plex Mono 500 15 in moss or rust. Beneath, 8 below: the sale line at monoMeta 11.5 in textBody, the price lifted to 500 textPrimary. sectionGap 24 to the hero.
Unplated: it is a status, not a card, and a fourth plate above hero, stat pair and desire card would read as one more card. The tag shares the outcome's line so 'SOLD' never sits beside the sale line's own 'Sold'.
VoiceOver: one element — 'Sold', the sale line, the outcome — in that order, whatever the visual order.
Beneath, the page as shipped, read-only: the desire card loses TAP OR DRAG and the level hint (it speaks about sell candidacy); no Market section, no Find a photo…. Gain: a stock photo, badge and credit kept, place recorded. Loss: the person's own photos, no place — the sale line ends at the price.
At cost (not drawn): the tag, then 'At cost' in textBody.
Surfaces 5 + 6 — the Sell Plan's Sold figure, row control and Sold section; the sale sheet.

Sell Plan.
Three figures in one plate: Selected · Sold · Estimated cost — Sold beside Selected, since the two are read together against the cost. Cells hug their content and share the spare width (space-between around the 1px dividers, at least 6 either side); the plate's side padding tightens from 16 to 12 in this mode, and each figure keeps one line and scales down (minimumScaleFactor 0.6, as the Dashboard's figures do) rather than clipping. Equal thirds would clip ESTIMATED COST. With three, Selected steps down to Archivo 26 so all three figures match; Sold is textPrimary; the colour cue is unchanged (Selected goes moss once Selected + Sold covers the cost — here $1,720 of $2,400, so brass).
Row control: a footer strip inside each candidate card — a 1px surfaceInset hairline, 40 tall, 'Mark as sold…' right-aligned in IBM Plex Sans 500 13, accentBrass — 002's candidate-card footer shape. The card body stays the selection toggle; the hairline is the boundary, and the control sits in the far corner from the checkbox. A text button because it only opens the sheet (filled writes, outlined fetches).
Sold section: unplated, the DETAILS rhythm, under the candidates — records, not choices, and a plate would read as one more selectable row. SOLD monoLabel, 10 below it the rows: 12 / 0 padding, surfaceInset hairline; name IBM Plex Sans 13 textPrimary (truncates), date monoMeta textMonoMeta, price IBM Plex Mono 500 13 textPrimary.

Sale sheet — the item form's field chrome at the medium detent; the large detent takes over when the keyboard rises.
Bar (system): Cancel in textBody, the title, the confirm in accentBrass semibold. No bottom save bar — at this size the fields and the bar fit without scrolling.
Row 1 pairs Sale price ($ in textQuiet, IBM Plex Mono 500 15) with Sold on (the item form's date button and calendar glyph; future days disabled in its popover) — the form's Price paid / Date bought row exactly, 10 apart. Sold at and Note are the form's plain text fields, IBM Plex Sans 13.5, placeholder in textInactive. sectionGap 24 between fields, 8 from label to field.
Plates at rest; a 1px accentRust border when the price is blank after confirming, with no message — the form's own rule.
